title: Agent-Driven Parametric 3D Building Generation via Natural Language Interface
task: 自然语言驱动的参数化3D建筑生成
inputData: 自然语言设计指令，解析为可执行的参数化建模意图与参数
contribution: 提出面向参数化3D建筑生成的自然语言智能体接口，将非结构化设计意图转译为结构化、可执行的参数化建模操作，降低传统参数化建模对专业命令和手工参数调整的依赖。
abstract: This work investigates an agent-driven natural-language interface for parametric 3D building generation. The system translates designers' textual intentions into structured commands and parameters that can drive a parametric modeling workflow, aiming to make architectural 3D generation more accessible while retaining explicit control over geometric design variables.
methodology: The proposed agent receives natural-language design requests, interprets design intent and relevant parameter slots, and converts them into structured commands for a parametric 3D building-generation workflow. The emphasis is on connecting conversational input to deterministic parametric operations rather than producing an image-only design output, allowing the generated instructions to be executed as editable geometric modeling actions.
results: The reported demonstrations show that natural-language interaction can be used to control parametric 3D building generation and lower the interaction barrier associated with manually editing parameter sets. The paper positions the agent interface as a bridge between high-level design intent and executable geometric modeling.
inputDataEn: Natural-language design instructions parsed into executable parametric modeling intents and parameters
operationEvidence: The implemented agent converts natural-language design intent into structured parametric modeling commands and uses those commands to generate or modify editable 3D building geometry.
